Hibernian vs Dundee United; Scottish Premiership
Hibernian vs Dundee United. Scottish Premiership.
Easter Road.
Hibernian 0
Dundee United 4
- Z Sapsford (8th minute, 39th minute)
- L Cameron (51st minute)
- J Randall (60th minute)
Hibernian 0-4 Dundee United: Zac Sapsford scores twice in record win at Easter Road
Report as Dundee United beat Hibs 4-0 at Easter Road; Zac Sapsford scored a double with Lyall Cameron and Jesse Randall also on target; United are unbeaten in eight as Hibernian drop to 11th in the Scottish Premiership
Saturday 21 November 2026 17:35, UK
Dundee United recorded their biggest win at Easter Road with an impressive 4-0 thrashing of Hibernian.
Zac Sapsford's first-half double laid the foundations before Lyall Cameron and Jesse Randall found the net after the break.
The visitors were well worth the three points as they cemented their place in the Premiership top six and picked up their first win in Leith since 2021.

It was a humbling afternoon for Hibs, who thought they had turned a corner under new head coach Marink Reedijk after back-to-back victories before the international break.
The hosts were forced into one change from the team that defeated Aberdeen 4-0 with Alex Williams, who came on for the injured Felix Passlack early in that game, retaining his place.
United were unchanged from last time out when a 1-1 draw at Motherwell stretched their unbeaten run to seven games.
It did not take long for the visitors to make their mark on the game with Jim Goodwin's side going ahead after just eight minutes through Sapsford.
The Australian won a penalty after he was caught in a clumsy challenge by Jason Kerr inside the area. Sapsford's effort down to the goalkeeper's right was saved by Rafa Sallinger but the ball rolled back to the attacker and he swept a left-footed shot into the net.
United had their tails up and Sallinger was called into action again to keep out Daniel Bennie's header at the back post from a Cameron corner.
Hibs struggled to settle but recorded their first attack of note in the 13th minute. Josh Mulligan drove away from Zidane Iqbal on the right flank and his cross was met by Joe Newell but his diving header was pushed behind by Jack Walton.
United continued to look lively at the other end and Sallinger repelled a low Dylan Tait shot with his feet.
Martin Boyle wasted a good chance for Hibs when he failed to make any meaningful contact on Mulligan's cut-back.
And United doubled their lead six minutes before the break when Sapsford added his second. Kevin Ciubotaru's cross from the left was met by Sapsford and he glanced a near-post header past Sallinger from six yards.
It got even better for United as they added two more within 15 minutes of the restart.
Cameron fired in the third in the 51st minute after Bennie's shot from the edge of the area came back off the post. The linesman raised his flag for offside and after a brief delay VAR overturned the decision.
Hibs head coach Reedijk made four changes but his team conceded a fourth on the hour mark. Dylan Tait had time to set up Randall and the forward buried a left-footed shot past Sallinger from 15 yards.
Hibs had chances to pull one back but Rabbi Matondo and Thibault Klidje were both left frustrated in front of goal.
digest_he:
דנדי יונייטד המשיכה את היכולת הנהדרת שלה וגברה בחוץ 4-0 על היברניאן, בתוך כדי שהיא רושמת את ניצחונה הגדול ביותר אי פעם באצטדיון איסטר רואד. המאורגן האוסטרלי זאק ספספורד כבש צמד במחצית הראשונה שהניח את היסודות לניצחון, כשכבש בריבאונד לאחר הצלה של השוער ובהמשך הוסיף שער נגיחה קליל.

במחצית השנייה השלימו לואל קמרון וג'סי רנדל את החגיגה, כשהשער של קמרון אושר לאחר בדיקת VAR. הניצחון מציב את דנדי יונייטד במקום הלחימה בצמרת הליגה הסקוטית ומאריך את רצף המשחקים ללא הפסד שלה, בעוד היברניאן ירדה למקום ה-11 בטבלה לאחר הופעה מאכזבת.
